# Day-ahead completions: validation (generated by `scripts/run_dayahead_ext.py`; part P2 of the completion batch)

Git commit `58ee272911`. Same task, samples and rules as the day-ahead model; scenario A unless labelled. MAE in MW over all (day, hour) samples (4,367). Hyper-parameters chosen on validation; early stopping on validation (mildly optimistic).

| model | validation MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| XGBoost S4, pooled (day-ahead model) | 3,585 |
| ridge (day-ahead model) | 3,799 |
| LSTM L4, pooled (day-ahead model) | 3,867 |
| XGBoost S4, one model per target hour | 3,643 |
| LSTM L1 (history + calendar), pooled | 3,746 |

## Feature ablation of the pooled XGBoost (hyper-parameters of the day-ahead S4 model)

| feature set | MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| S0_history | 4,038 |
| S1_calendar | 3,692 |
| S2_holidays | 3,749 |
| S3_weatherA | 3,547 |
| S5_oracle_B (oracle weather, upper bound) | 3,527 |
| S6_forecastC (archived temperature forecasts; issue times unverified) | 3,677 |
| S4_full_A (the day-ahead model) | 3,585 |

## XGBoost quantile regression (raw 5%-95% interval)

Raw coverage 87.5% (nominal 90%), mean width 15,242 MW; conformal calibration and comparison with the other interval methods are in the analysis report.

Run time 7,568 s.
